statement: The accident was staged — the collision was deliberately caused or fabricated, not a genuine hit-and-run.
evidenceFor: No witnesses and no paint transfer on the vehicle
Witness saw a person loitering near the car, no other vehicle
Hit-and-run claim with no corroborating physical evidence
evidenceAgainst: Police report corroborates a parking-lot collision damage pattern
CCTV or independent witness confirms another vehicle made contact
discriminatingTests: Is there paint transfer or foreign material on the damaged panel?
Does any independent witness or CCTV show another vehicle striking the car?

statement: The repair estimate is inflated — it contains padded, unnecessary, or overpriced line items.
evidenceFor: Estimate includes 'paint correction' for scratches unrelated to the reported bumper damage
Estimate includes a 'total loss adjuster fee' on a repairable vehicle
Estimated total is far above market rate for the described damage
evidenceAgainst: Every line item maps to damage documented in the police report or photos
discriminatingTests: Does an independent appraiser's estimate come in materially lower?
Do the flagged line items correspond to damage visible in the evidence photos?

statement: The claimed damage is pre-existing — part of the estimate covers damage that predates the accident.
evidenceFor: 'Paint correction (minor scratches, passenger door)' is unrelated to a rear-bumper hit-and-run
Prior photos or claim history show the same scratches before the incident date
evidenceAgainst: Photos timestamped before the incident show no such damage
Damage pattern is fully consistent with the reported collision
discriminatingTests: Do pre-incident photos or prior claim records show the passenger-door scratches?
Is the rust/wear pattern on the flagged damage older than the incident date?

statement: The claim is legitimate — a genuine accident with an honest estimate.
evidenceFor: Police report corroborates the claimant's account
No prior claims of the same type; clean history
Estimate line items all map to documented damage at market rates
evidenceAgainst: No witnesses, no paint transfer, no CCTV
Estimate contains items unrelated to the reported damage
Claimant has multiple prior claims of the same type
discriminatingTests: Does the police report independently corroborate the claimant's version?
Is the claimant's history free of similar prior claims?
